# id: # Round two (2026-11-13): the owner's nine concepts (LIB_LLMOUT/Read/LIB_GAMES/game_templates_to_make.txt).

title: Vector Pong 3D
brief: A tennis court seen in 3D from behind your bat: the ball flies away into depth and back. The player slides the bat left, right, up and down; the computer bat is at the far end. Shots can be angled off the side walls and the ceiling. Floating obstacle blocks in mid-court bounce the ball. A point when the ball passes a bat.
level columns: ball speed | computer bat speed | obstacle count | points to win
layout legend: . empty, # obstacle block, o ball start

title: Jai Alai Block
brief: A little runner with a scoop at the bottom of an arena hurls a ball up at a ceiling made of blocks. Blocks that are hit come loose and fall. The runner must catch the ball in the scoop when it comes back and dodge the falling blocks. Clear the ceiling to finish the level; lose a life when a block lands on the runner or the ball hits the floor.
level columns: ball speed | block rows | fall speed | lives
layout legend: . empty, B block, S strong block (two hits), # solid

title: Floppy Flynn
brief: Side view, scrolling. A blue two-legged vector ship with a bad ankle flaps to stay up: each tap lifts it, gravity pulls it down. It flies through gaps in destructible terrain. A crash does not kill: it tears one loose part off the ship, and the terrain breaks. When too few parts are left the ship cannot fly and plummets. Distance is the score.
level columns: scroll speed | gap height | gravity | ship parts
layout legend: . empty, # terrain block, G gap marker

title: Vector Blob Apocalypse
brief: Top-down, seen at an angle. The player sits in the middle, spins and shoots. Jittery vector jelly blobs swarm in from every side; big ones split into small ones when hit. Bullets everywhere. Survive the wave to finish the level; lose a life when a blob touches the player.
level columns: blob count | blob speed | split count | lives
layout legend: . empty, b blob start, P player

title: Prompt And Glaze Maze
brief: Two agents, PROMPT and GLAZE, collect every energy dot in a maze while patrol enemies chase them. A powerup gives a polyhedron to throw: it bounces around corners and loses sides at every strike until it is gone. Thrown by GLAZE it charms enemies to follow as friends for a few seconds; thrown by PROMPT it de-rezzes them. TAB swaps who you play. Collect all the energy to finish the level.
level columns: enemy count | enemy speed | powerups | lives
layout legend: # wall, . energy dot, o powerup, E enemy start, P PROMPT start, G GLAZE start

title: Shaft Descent
brief: Side view. A runner descends a tall vertical shaft of platforms inside a vector world: run, jump with a real jump curve, drop through gaps, avoid patrol drones, reach the exit at the bottom before the air runs out. The camera follows down the shaft.
level columns: platform rows | drone count | drone speed | air seconds
layout legend: . empty, = platform, D drone start, P player start, X exit

title: Matrix Lock
brief: A figure stands on a grid floor while 3D wireframe shapes made of cubes drop from above, one at a time. The player walks out of the way and can rotate the falling shape. Shapes stay where they land. A filled row of the floor clears. The level ends when enough rows are cleared; the life is lost if the figure is walled in with no free cell to step to, or a shape lands on it.
level columns: fall speed | rows to clear | shape kinds | lives
layout legend: . empty, # landed cube, P player start

title: Big Ball Of Vectors
brief: Roll a security polyhedron across an open grid to catch rogue agents that run from it. The ball starts crude, with few sides, and gains sides and size with every catch. Entanglement hazards drift on the map: touching one makes the ball go rogue and roll on its own for a moment. Every agent that escapes off the edge adds a hazard. Catch the quota to finish the level.
level columns: agent count | agent speed | hazard count | catch quota
layout legend: . empty, A agent start, H hazard, P ball start

title: Probe Vs Cone
brief: A small runner throws a logic-probe spear at a boss guarded by rings of shield cubes. A cube that is hit breaks and drops a key token; collect the tokens to assemble the password. Every few seconds the shield updates: cubes from the inner ring move out to fill the gaps of the outer ring. A spear that misses keeps bouncing off walls and is dangerous until it lies still and is picked up; a spear that breaks a cube returns to the hand. Hit the boss with the password complete to win the level.
level columns: shield rings | update seconds | spear speed | lives
layout legend: . empty, C shield cube, B boss, P player start
